A mushroom field journal for the Mudita Kompakt, built for its E Ink screen.

It does not tell you what a mushroom is, and it will never tell you whether one is
edible. What it does is let you write a mushroom down properly while you are standing
over it, and then help you work out what you are looking at once you get home. The
shortlist is always what has *not* been ruled out, never an answer.

Nothing in the taxon pack has been checked by a mycologist, and every page says so.

No network permission at all, and no location unless you turn it on — see
[PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).

Verify the download against the `.sha256` beside it if you like. `kinokocho.apk` and
`kinokocho-<version>.apk` are the same file; the unversioned one is there so that a link
to it keeps working after the next release.

Free software under the GPLv3.
